sentences.text:
Opposite Party
 Mr. P. K. Mohanty, Asc
 Coram: Justice V. Narasingh

Order
22.03.2023 Order No.
Heard learned counsel for the Petitioner and learned counsel for the State.

2. The Petitioner is an accused in S.T. Case No.01 of 2021 pending on the file of learned Addl.
Sessions Judge, Paralakhemundi, arising out of Seranga P.S. Case No.46 of 2020 for commission of the alleged offence under Sections 376(2)(n)/419 IPC.
3.
Being aggrieved by the rejection of his application for bail U/s.439 Cr.P.C. by the learned Addl.
Sessions Judge, Paralakhemundi by order dated 16.08.2022 in the aforementioned case, the present BLAPL has been filed.
4. I.A No.1828 of 2022 has been filed by the Petitioner for interim bail on account of illness of the wife of the Petitioner.

5. Perused the report submitted by the concerned I.I.C. placed by the learned counsel for the State.
The same is taken on record.
6.
Taking note of the same, this Court is not inclined to entertain this application for interim release.
7. Accordingly, I.A. stands rejected.
8. It is stated at the Bar that by order dated 20.06.2022 in BLAPL No.4753 of 2021, this Court called Joyanta @ Jayanta Raita vs State Of Odisha ....

entities.text: Joyanta @ Jayanta Raita vs State Of Odisha
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Opposite Party

on 22 March, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/46588969/
1 upon the learned Court in seisin to conclude the trial within a period of six months.
9. On perusal of the impugned order of rejection, ex facie it is seen that the order of this Court was not brought to the notice of the learned Court in seisin.

10. Be that as it may, the Petitioner is stated to be in custody since 05.10.2020, learned Court in seisin is called upon to conclude the trial within a period of six months hence.
11.
Registry is requested to communicate the order to the learned Court in seisin.
12. With the aforesaid order, this BLAPL stands disposed of.
13. Urgent certified copy of this order be granted as per rule.
(V. NARASINGH) Judge PKS Joyanta @ Jayanta Raita vs State Of Odisha ....
